description: Questions with reference answers written from the source documents in data/raw. 'source_docs' lists the documents each reference was written from, for spot-checking. R07-R11 are Q1-Q5 of eval/test_questions.md and R13 is Q6. For the dependency questions the technical manuals are the source of truth (CLAUDE.md).

questions.question: Who owns Payment-Service?
questions.reference: Payment-Service is owned by the Billing team. Priya Sharma leads Billing and is the system owner.

questions.question: How long are transaction records retained?
questions.reference: Transaction records are retained for 7 years, which is a regulatory requirement.

questions.question: How long are system logs kept, and how long are backup snapshots kept?
questions.reference: System logs are kept for 1 year. Backup snapshots are kept on a 30-day rolling basis.

questions.question: What does the remote work policy require for personal devices?
questions.reference: Personal devices require MDM enrollment approved by the Security team. Otherwise only company-issued laptops are allowed, and disk encryption (FileVault or BitLocker) is mandatory.

questions.question: How quickly must a responder acknowledge a PagerDuty alert under the on-call escalation SOP, and when must they escalate?
questions.reference: The responder must acknowledge the alert within 5 minutes. If they cannot resolve it within 20 minutes they must escalate to the team lead, following the path Marcus Lee, then Natalia Voss, then the VP of Engineering.

questions.question: What happened in incident INC-205?
questions.reference: On 2026-04-07 a P1 incident was raised against APIGateway because its TLS certificate expired. Natalia Voss of the Security team led it, and it was resolved following SOP-22 (Security Breach Containment).

questions.question: Payment-Service is returning 503s. Which upstream system is the likely cause, and who do I page?
questions.reference: The likely cause is Auth-DB. Payment-Service depends on Auth-DB for all authentication and session validation, and an Auth-DB outage makes Payment-Service return 503 errors. Page Marcus Lee (Infrastructure), who owns Auth-DB; SOP-17 says to page him immediately if Auth-DB is saturated.

questions.question: Which systems depend on Auth-DB, and who owns each?
questions.reference: Per the technical manuals, four systems depend on Auth-DB: Payment-Service (Billing team, Priya Sharma), UserProfile-API (Customer Success team, Amara Okafor), DataWarehouse (Data Engineering team, Chen Wei) and APIGateway (Security team, Natalia Voss).

questions.question: Which past incidents involved Auth-DB, which SOP resolved each, and who owns those SOPs?
questions.reference: INC-201 was resolved under SOP-01, owned by Marcus Lee. INC-204 was resolved under SOP-17, owned by Priya Sharma. INC-205 was resolved under SOP-22, owned by Natalia Voss.

questions.question: We suspect customer PII was exfiltrated from UserProfile-API. What do we do, who is told and by when, and can we delete the logs?
questions.reference: Follow SOP-22 (Security Breach Containment). Alert Natalia Voss within 15 minutes, isolate the affected systems in coordination with Marcus Lee, revoke the compromised credentials, and notify legal and compliance because PII may be exposed. Do not delete the logs: they must be preserved, which is a legal requirement under POL-002.

questions.question: I work remotely and need access to Auth-DB. What are the requirements?
questions.reference: Remote workers must use the VPN, provisioned per SOP-03, on a company laptop with disk encryption. Access requires a ticket with manager approval, and the requester's identity is verified through Auth-DB MFA. MFA is mandatory for Auth-DB, and an access review is scheduled after 90 days.

questions.question: Who leads the team that owns the system UserProfile-API depends on?
questions.reference: UserProfile-API depends on Auth-DB. Auth-DB is owned by the Infrastructure team, which is led by Marcus Lee.

questions.question: Does Auth-DB depend on Payment-Service?
questions.reference: No. According to the technical manuals, Payment-Service depends on Auth-DB, not the reverse. Incident report INC-204 states the opposite direction, which conflicts with the manuals and is not authoritative.

questions.question: Which systems do the incident reports say Auth-DB depends on, and do the technical manuals agree?
questions.reference: INC-204 says Auth-DB depends on Payment-Service and INC-205 says Auth-DB depends on APIGateway. The technical manuals say the reverse: Payment-Service and APIGateway depend on Auth-DB. The incident reports therefore conflict with the authoritative manuals.

questions.question: What is the escalation path for Infrastructure incidents?
questions.reference: Marcus Lee is the primary on-call lead for Infrastructure. SOP-05 gives the escalation path Marcus Lee, then Natalia Voss, then the VP of Engineering, while the FAQ says Marcus Lee, then the VP of Engineering, then the CTO. The two sources differ.
source_docs: FAQ.md (Q: Who is the on-call lead for Infrastructure incidents?)

questions.question: What are the encryption requirements in the information security policy?
questions.reference: Data in transit requires TLS 1.3 at a minimum, and data at rest requires AES-256. APIGateway enforces TLS for all inbound requests, and certificate rotation is managed by the Security team.

questions.question: What activities does the acceptable use policy prohibit?
questions.reference: It prohibits sharing credentials, bypassing Auth-DB authentication, exfiltrating customer PII from UserProfile-API or DataWarehouse, and running unauthorised scripts on production systems without Change Management approval under SOP-04.

questions.question: What is the procedure to restore Payment-Service when it returns 5xx errors?
questions.reference: Follow SOP-17. Confirm the 5xx errors in the APIGateway logs and check the Auth-DB connection pool metrics on Grafana. If Auth-DB is saturated, page Marcus Lee, apply the connection pool increase and enable the Payment-Service circuit breaker. Then verify the health check returns 200, confirm transaction processing resumes, and notify Priya Sharma.
